situation: 犬のかき氷屋はてんてこ舞いだ。まさに＿＿＿！
english: The dog's shave ice shop is swamped, ___!
explanation: 猫の手も借りたい (neko no te mo karitai) = どんな微力でも助けが欲しいほど忙しい
englishExplanation: to be so busy you'd even take help from a cat (any help at all)

situation: 町を散歩していた犬が、偶然にも宝の地図を見つけた。これはまさに＿＿＿だね！
english: A dog taking a walk around town happened to find a treasure map. This is truly ___!
completedKanyouku: 犬も歩けば棒に当たる
explanation: 犬も歩けば棒に当たる (inu mo arukeba bou ni ataru) = 行動すれば思わぬ幸運（または災難）に出会う
englishExplanation: even a dog that walks around will bump into a stick — action brings unexpected luck (or trouble)

situation: 今月のお小遣いはたったの100円…これじゃあ＿＿＿ほどしかないよ！
english: This month's allowance is only 100 yen... that's barely ___!
explanation: スズメの涙 (suzume no namida) = ほんのわずかな量
englishExplanation: a sparrow's tears — an extremely small amount

situation: 料理人を目指す少年に、プロの料理を見せても意味がない。まさに＿＿＿だ！
english: Showing professional cuisine to a boy just starting out as a chef is pointless. It's truly ___!
explanation: 猫に小判 (neko ni koban) = 価値のわからない者に貴重なものを与えても無駄なこと
englishExplanation: gold coins to a cat — giving something valuable to someone who can't appreciate it

situation: 決勝戦、両チームの実力は互角。まさに＿＿＿の勝負だ！
english: The final match — both teams are evenly matched. It's truly a ___ battle!
explanation: 竜虎相打つ (ryuuko ai utsu) = 実力の伯仲した強者同士が激しく戦うこと
englishExplanation: dragon and tiger clash — two equally powerful rivals in fierce combat
